name: browser-workflow-2
description: Claude builds, runs and fixes browser workflows in your own Chrome, with the Browser Workflow extension.
long_description: Browser Workflow lets you describe a task on a website and have Claude turn it into a workflow that runs again any time, without Claude. The workflows run in your own Chrome, in a tab group of their own, through the Browser Workflow extension; what they collect stays in Chrome. This app is the part that lets Claude talk to that extension.

tools.name: extension_status
tools.description: Whether Browser Workflow is ready in Chrome, and what to do when it is not.
